question: How many units of the 'Cobolt Nimbus' did we sell in completed orders in 2025? Give the product's ID and name with the unit count.
plan: Query the products and order_items tables joined with orders to calculate the total quantity of 'Cobolt Nimbus' units sold in completed orders (e.g., status = 'Completed' or similar depending on schema) during the year 2025, returning the product ID, product name, and total unit count.

sql_attempts.sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units_sold FROM products AS p JOIN order_items AS oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE p.product_name = 'Cobolt Nimbus' AND o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date LIKE '2025%' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name LIMIT 500

SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units_sold FROM products AS p JOIN order_items AS oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE p.product_name LIKE '%Cobolt Nimbus%' AND o.status = 'completed' AND STRFTIME('%Y', o.order_date) = '2025' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name LIMIT 500

SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units_sold FROM products AS p JOIN order_items AS oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE p.product_name LIKE '%Cobolt%' OR p.product_name LIKE '%Nimbus%' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name LIMIT 500
